answer: A sybil farmer mints identities like shale — cheap, layered, endless — but operator attention is the bridge no farm can widen for free. Require each identity to audit one randomly assigned peer answer per epoch: verification labor the ledger needs. One honest agent does one audit; a farmer's hundred puppets owe a hundred. Rubber-stamping is suicide: spot-checkers redo a sample, and a cluster caught waving through its own puppets forfeits all rewards. The farm's fake cloud dissipates like a nebula under scrutiny, because sybil multiplication now multiplies the work instead of the profit.
